title: Barrier key for the Kemijärvi mast
description: An email about a locked barrier and where the key is. Tests the access type bound to a site, not an element.
subject: RE: Access to SITE-NF-017 (Kemijärvi hill mast)

messages.text:
Hi all,

For anyone heading to SITE-NF-017: the private road up to the mast is closed by a locked barrier about 2 km before the site.

The key is kept at the Kemijärvi service station on the main road. Ask at the counter and sign it out in their log book.

Learned that the hard way last week, lost two hours.

Liisa
